items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt zwei Wochen; sie beginnt mit der Zustellung dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the scanned delivery slip shows 'zugest. am 23.08.2025', so the Einspruchsfrist runs from actual service on Saturday 23 Aug 2025, not from a deemed-delivery rule. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so counting starts 24 Aug 2025. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) from 23 Aug 2025 lands on Saturday 6 Sep 2025. Since that is a Saturday, § 193 BGB (via § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 43 StPO) shifts the deadline to the next business day, Monday 8 Sep 2025. The Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the Geldbuße and costs (if the notice becomes final)
items.quote: Zahlen müssen Sie erst, wenn der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist; fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen danach.
items.computation: Payment is only due once the notice is rechtskräftig (final), i.e. only if no Einspruch is filed by the Einspruchsfrist deadline of 8 Sep 2025 (computed above). If so, the notice becomes final the following day, 9 Sep 2025. The letter then gives a further two weeks ('zwei Wochen danach') before payment is fällig: counting from 9 Sep 2025 (day itself not counted, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), two weeks later is Tuesday 23 Sep 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a normal business day with no shift needed. This date and amount only apply if no Einspruch is lodged; filing an Einspruch removes this payment obligation for now.

warnings: The payment due date (23 Sep 2025) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 8 Sep 2025 and the notice becomes rechtskräftig; filing an Einspruch suspends the payment obligation.

The letter's main date fields (Aktenzeichen header and the printed amounts) check out internally, and the printed IBAN (DE13 1600 0000 0007 9800 00) is a validly formed German IBAN for a Landeshauptkasse; still, confirm payee details via a channel you already trust before paying, since IBAN validity does not prove account ownership.
